steps.message: Go to the new contact screen and enter the following details: First Name: Ivan, Last Name: Adams, Phone: 725-130-4440, Phone Label: Work. Do NOT hit save.
Execute: adb shell "am start -a android.intent.action.INSERT -t vnd.android.cursor.dir/contact --es name 'Ivan Adams' --es phone '725-130-4440' --ei phone_type 3"
